[developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Long-term differences between countries and population groups arise from productivity, distribution of resources, and rules of social interaction. Growth does not necessarily improve everyone's living conditions equally.

**User-friendly description (mr):** समाजांमध्ये संपत्ती, संधी आणि जीवनमान का भिन्न असते ते जाणून घ्या.

Skills: 4

**Methodological description (English):** Distributions of income and wealth can differ even among societies with identical average incomes.

**User-friendly description (mr):** सरासरी उत्पन्नावरून संसाधनांचे वाटप का कळत नाही ते पाहा.

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a summary index of inequality and its limits in describing the shape of a distribution.

**User-friendly description (mr):** जिनी गुणांक समजून घ्या, पण तो सर्व माहिती देतो असे समजू नका.

[incomeDistribution.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/incomeDistribution.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (mr):** विविध गटांमध्ये उत्पन्न कसे विभागले आहे याची तुलना करा.

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the relationship between parents' economic position and the opportunities available to the next generation.

**User-friendly description (mr):** कुटुंबाची परिस्थिती पुढील पिढीच्या संधी कशा घडवते ते पाहा.

[wealthDistribution.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/wealthDistribution.data.ts)
